🚗 Team Draura brought driver safety to life at ShellHacks 2025 using Google Cloud’s ADK and Gemini!

After witnessing a serious crash on their way to the event, the team set out to rethink how people learn to drive safely. Draura is a 3D driving simulation that blends real Google Maps data with retro Game Boy-style visuals, letting players navigate real streets, face real hazards, and answer safety questions in real time.

Powered by multi-agent systems built with Google ADK, the game’s AI agents generate dynamic, location-aware scenarios and questions based on real-world traffic data. It’s educational, immersive, and surprisingly fun — turning serious safety training into an engaging experience.
